title: Diagonal affine-model trace and finite-level site comparison
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient data of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $S$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], $d\geq0$, and $p_d:V=\mathbf A^d_S\to S$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. Use ordinary etale and small pro-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], their specified twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], tensor and pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], compact supports [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] and exceptional adjunction [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(S_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], let $\gamma_{p_d,K}$ be the smooth purity map using the diagonal/DNC orientation [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], and set
$$s_{d,K}=\epsilon_{p_d,K}\circ Rp_{d!}(\gamma_{p_d,K})$$
as in [def-pur-smooth-trace].

Let $t_d^p:Rp_{d!}^pA_V(d)[2d]\to A_S$ be ordered integration of the $d$ restricted Kummer-normalized projective-line traces, with the identity for $d=0$ [def-amb-p1-trace, def-amb-vector-integration, lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison]. Write $a^p_{d,K}$ for inverse coefficient-first projection followed by $1_K\otimes t_d^p$ and the unitor [def-exchange-projection]. Then, with the canonical twist reassociation,
$$s_{d,K}=a^p_{d,K}:Rp_{d!}^p(Lp_d^*K(d)[2d])\longrightarrow K.$$

More precisely, choose any $r\geq1$ annihilating $A$ by $\ell^r$ and use the ordinary etale twist $L_T=\mu_{\ell^r,T}^{\mathrm{et}}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/\ell^r}A_T$. Write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ for comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. For $K_0\in D^b_{ctf}(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ let $a^e_{d,K_0}$ be the ordinary integration arrow and $\eta^e_{d,K_0}$ its exceptional adjoint transpose. Under the actual Tate, source, compact-support and counit-preserving exceptional comparisons of [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison], one has
$$\gamma_{p_d,C_SK_0}=C_V(\eta^e_{d,K_0}),\qquad s_{d,C_SK_0}\circ\beta_{d,K_0}=C_S(a^e_{d,K_0}),$$
where $\beta_{d,K_0}$ denotes that lemma's compact-support comparison evaluated at $Lp_d^*K_0\otimes_A^LL_V(d)[2d]$ and followed by its source identification. At $d=0$ both purity and trace maps are identities. The projective-line trace used here satisfies $t_q^ph_q^p=1$ on the prescribed Kummer class. These equalities are independent of $r$ and hold at every $E,n$; no divisibility of $n$ by the ramification index is assumed.
